paite: Mihat omkhawmte lak ah Pathian adingh a; pathiante lak ah vai ahawm hi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Pathian, Vaihawmpa Tungnungpen
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

paite: Bang tan ahia dikloutak a vai na hawm ua, migilou-saloute, na deihsak tuam ding uh?
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

paite: Gentheite leh pa neiloute hawmsak unla; haksa thuakte, tagahte tung ah hihdik un.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

paite: Gentheite leh tagahte gum unla; migilou-salou khut a kipan humbit un.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

paite: Athei kei ua, theihsiamna leng anei kei uh; mial ah akileh akileh ua; leilung kingakna tengteng alingta hi;
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

paite: pathiante na hi ua, na vek un Tungnungpen tate na hi uh, ka chi hi.
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

paite: Himahleh mihingte bang phet in na hong si ding ua, milian khat bang in na hong puk ding uhi.
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

paite: Pathian aw, thou inla, lei vai hawmsak in, nam chih na gouluah ding ahi uhi.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.
